name: Artifikial
source:
It is not clear where, it is not clear how you woke up in a new unknown world. Everything in front of you — endless ruins, but someone pulls you out of thoughts. This someone turns out to be a strange girl who so wants to tell her story. Accept her invitation by downloading the game. Make tea or coffee, cover yourself with a blanket and enjoy a short story to euthanizing ambient music.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240105013747/https://kofeman.itch.io/artifikial]itch.io[/url]]
